brief: Today's posts centered on agents and Claude's new workspace features, including Claude Data, interactive connectors and Box read/write access via MCP. Dan Shipper's day-zero tests of Google's Gemini 4 Carbon were also prominent, along with Vercel's Agent-run security review.

themes.label: Claude workspace updates
themes.summary: Builders highlighted Claude Data going generally available, interactive connectors for Adobe, Atlassian and Box, and new Whiteboards and Sheets features.

themes.label: Agent swarms and workflows
themes.summary: Aaron Levie argued agent swarms will separate teams by output, while Ryo Lu said collaboration with humans matters more than siloed agents.

themes.label: Gemini 4 Carbon testing
themes.summary: Dan Shipper tested Gemini 4 Carbon, finding it a stronger coder than Argon but not always knowing when to stop, and Josh Woodward noted its rollout to Ultra subscribers.

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.summary: Argued that agent swarms could drive another leap in output and that agents will work with enterprise files far more than people do. Announced a Box read/write partnership with Anthropic via MCP for Claude.

builders.name: Claude
builders.summary: Announced Claude Data as generally available on paid plans, interactive connectors for Adobe, Atlassian and Box, and a rollout of Whiteboards, Sheets and Data.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Reported Vercel Security Review found 57,897 vulnerabilities in under a week, with the Agent patching 14,665. Also argued that new purpose-built languages will emerge with agentic coding.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary: Published a day-zero vibe check of Gemini 4 Carbon, reporting a 44% Senior Engineer benchmark score versus Argon's 21% and an overrun in a backlog test.

builders.name: Latent Space
builders.summary: Published a podcast episode with Zeno Rocha of Resend on designing for agents, covering Resend's growth to 4.3 million users.

builders.name: Peter Steinberger
builders.summary: Shared a report on a company whose re-run diagnostics with GPT-6 Astra confirmed 35,000 new vulnerabilities after earlier fixes.

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Asked Resend's CEO why agents keep choosing Resend, and teased a keynote at the AIE live stream on Thursday.

builders.name: Thariq
builders.summary: Said the field needs fewer one-shot demos and more tools for collaborating with models.

builders.name: Ryo Lu
builders.summary: Argued that human collaboration matters more than siloed agents, and shared a piece on building software that lets people in.

builders.name: Josh Woodward
builders.summary: Announced that Gemini 4 Carbon is available to Ultra subscribers worldwide in the Gemini app.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Recommended a Railway post-mortem as a must read for infra providers, and otherwise posted personal or minor content.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary: Posted brief, personal or minor content with no substantive product or technical details.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Praised Anthropic's focus on accelerating disease cures and defended tasteful AI use in game development.

builders.name: Aditya Agarwal
builders.summary: Posted a short personal remark about successful friends having intense hobbies.

builders.name: Zara Zhang
builders.summary: Shared advice on sharing work in progress and on why users stop returning to a product.

builders.name: Nan Yu
builders.summary: Praised a dictation app's support for the Apple dictation key and push-to-talk shortcuts, and otherwise posted minor replies.
